item.title: Mila Resources doubles gold resource at Coffey to 41,000 ounces
item.summary: Mila Resources has roughly doubled the gold resource at its Coffey deposit in Western Australia, as the explorer weighs the future development of its Kathleen Valley project. The company said an updated JORC estimate put Coffey’s inferred mineral resource at 41,300 ounces of contained gold, up from 21,000 ounces reported in 2020.
